title: Ravana instructs Indrajit to enter the battle field
introduction: Ravana instructs Indrajit to proceed to the battle field. Before proceeding t the battle, Indrajit performs ceremorial oblations into a sacred fire and obtains a capacity of going out of sight while fighting. He proceeds to the battle-field and releases a flood of arrows towards Rama and Lakshmana, while himself remaining invisible in the sky. With a network of arrows, Indrajit creates a darkness in the sky and showers a multitude of steel arrows towards Rama and Lakshmana. Sharp golden shafts arrows are then released by Rama and Lakshmana. Struck by the arrows discharged by Indrajit, monkeys in hundreds fall down dead. Then, Rama and Lakshmana reflect on the various ways and means to destroy Indrajit.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे अशीतितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 80th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
मकराक्षंहतं श्रुत्वा रावणः समितिंजयः |
रोषेण महताविष्टो दन्तान् कटकटाय्य च
कोपितश्च तदा तत्र किं कार्यमिति चिन्तयन् |
आदिदेशाथ सम्क्रुद्धो रणायेन्द्रजितं सुतम्
verses.iast:
makarākṣaṃhataṃ śrutvā rāvaṇaḥ samitiñjayaḥ |
roṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭo dantān kaṭakaṭāyya ca
kopitaśca tadā tatra kiṃ kāryamiti cintayan |
ādideśātha samkruddho raṇāyendrajitaṃ sutam
verses.translation: On hearing Makaraksha having been killed, Ravana who had been ever victorious in battle, grinding his teeth in rage, reflected on what to do then and there, and as greatly furious as he was, instructed Indrajit, his son to proceed to the battle-field.

glosses.meaning: who had ever seen victorious in battle

verses.devanagari:
जहि वीर महावीर्यौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ |
अदृश्यो दृश्यमानो वा सर्वथा त्वं बलाधिकः
verses.iast:
jahi vīra mahāvīryau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau |
adṛśyo dṛśyamāno vā sarvathā tvaṃ balādhikaḥ
verses.translation: "O hero! Either remaining yourself invisible or visible, kill Rama and Lakshmana, the brothers of great prowess. You are superior in strength by all means."

verses.devanagari:
त्वमप्रतिमकर्माणमिन्द्रं जयसि संयुगे |
किं पुनर्मानुषौ दृष्ट्वा न वधिष्यसि संयुगे
verses.iast:
tvamapratimakarmāṇamindraṃ jayasi saṃyuge |
kiṃ punarmānuṣau dṛṣṭvā na vadhiṣyasi saṃyuge
verses.translation: "You have conquered Indra, of incomparable deeds, in battle. Can you not kill those two men, on seeing them in the battle-field?"

verses.devanagari:
तथोक्तो राक्षसेन्द्रेण प्रतिगृह्य पितुर्वचः |
यज्ञभूमौ स विधिवत् पावकं जुहवेन्द्रजित्
verses.iast:
tathokto rākṣasendreṇa pratigṛhya piturvacaḥ |
yajJṇabhūmau sa vidhivat pāvakaṃ juhavendrajit
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Ravana, that Indrajit, bowing to the command of his father, poured oblations into the sacred fire, with due ceremony, on the sacrificial ground.

verses.devanagari:
जुह्वतश्चापि तत्राग्निं रक्तोष्णीषधराः स्त्रियः |
आजग्मुस्तत्र सम्भ्रान्ता राक्षस्यो यत्र रावणिः
verses.iast:
juhvataścāpi tatrāgniṃ raktoṣṇīṣadharāḥ striyaḥ |
ājagmustatra sambhrāntā rākṣasyo yatra rāvaṇiḥ
verses.translation: Even as he was pouring oblations into the sacred fire there, the female-demons carrying red turbans (for the use of priests) hastily arrived at the spot where Indrajit was there.

glosses.meaning: even as he was pouring oblations into the sacred fire
carrying red turbans (for the use of priests)

verses.devanagari:
शस्त्राणि शरपत्राणि समिधो|अ अथ विभीतकाः |
लोहितानि च वासांसि स्रुवं कार्ष्णायसं तथा
verses.iast:
śastrāṇi śarapatrāṇi samidho | a atha vibhītakāḥ |
lohitāni ca vāsāṃsi sruvaṃ kārṣṇāyasaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Weapons (such as a lance) served as blades of Shara grass (for being spread around the sacrificial fire). Chips of wood of Vibhitaka tree served as wooden sticks to feed the sacrificial fire as also red robes and iron ladles were used for cleaning and pouring clarified melted butter into the sacrificial fire.

glosses.meaning: served as blades of Shara grass (for being spread around the sacrificial fire)
chips of wood of Vibhitaka tree
served as wooden sticks to feed the sacrificial fire
(were used) for cleaning and pouring clarified melted butter into the sacrificial fire.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वतो|अग्निं समास्तीर्य शरपत्रैः सतोमरैः |
चागस्य सर्वकृष्णस्य गलं जग्राह जीवतः
verses.iast:
sarvato | agniṃ samāstīrya śarapatraiḥ satomaraiḥ |
cāgasya sarvakṛṣṇasya galaṃ jagrāha jīvataḥ
verses.translation: Having spread on the ground around all the sides of the sacrificial fire with other weapons along with lances, the demon seized hold of the neck of a live goat, entirely black and consigned it to the fire.

glosses.meaning: around all the sides of the sacrificial fire
entirely black (and consigned it to the fire).

verses.devanagari:
सकृद्धोमसमिद्धस्य विधूमस्य महार्चिषः |
बभूवुस्तानि लिङ्गानि विजयं दर्शयन्ति च
verses.iast:
sakṛddhomasamiddhasya vidhūmasya mahārciṣaḥ |
babhūvustāni liṇ^gāni vijayaṃ darśayanti ca
verses.translation: Such omens as betokened victory appeared in the smokeless fire which burst into mighty flames, when it was fully aroused by that single offering.

glosses.meaning: fire which burst into mighty flames

verses.devanagari:
प्रदक्षिणावर्तशिखस्तप्तहाटकसन्निभः |
हविस्तत्प्रतिजग्राह पावकः स्वयमुत्थितः
verses.iast:
pradakṣiṇāvartaśikhastaptahāṭakasannibhaḥ |
havistatpratijagrāha pāvakaḥ svayamutthitaḥ
verses.translation: Becoming visible in person, the god of fire, who was shooting out flames towards the right and who shone brightly like refined gold, received that offering.

glosses.meaning: who was shooting out flames towards the right
and who shone brightly like refined gold

verses.devanagari:
हुत्वाग्निम् तर्पयित्वाथ देवदानवराक्षसान् |
आरुरोह रथश्रेष्ठमन्तर्धानगरं शुभम्
verses.iast:
hutvāgnim tarpayitvātha devadānavarākṣasān |
āruroha rathaśreṣṭhamantardhānagaraṃ śubham
verses.translation: Offering oblations in fire and gratifying the gods, the devils and demons, Indrajit ascended an excellent and splendid chariot, capable of disappearing from sight.

verses.devanagari:
स वाजिभिश्चतुर्भिस्तु बाणैस्तु निशितैर्युतः |
आरोपितमहाचापः शुशुभे स्यन्दनोत्तमः
verses.iast:
sa vājibhiścaturbhistu bāṇaistu niśitairyutaḥ |
āropitamahācāpaḥ śuśubhe syandanottamaḥ
verses.translation: Drawn by four horses, provided with sharp arrows and a mighty bow placed on it, that excellent chariot looked beautiful.

glosses.meaning: and a mighty bow placed on it

verses.devanagari:
जाज्वल्यमानो वपुषा तपनीयपरिच्छदः |
मृगैश्चन्द्रार्धचन्द्रैश्च स रथः समलंकृतः
verses.iast:
jājvalyamāno vapuṣā tapanīyaparicchadaḥ |
mṛgaiścandrārdhacandraiśca sa rathaḥ samalaṅkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Adorned with gold, that chariot glittered on account of its body and was decorated with carved images of antelopes, full moons and crescents.

verses.devanagari:
जाम्बूनदमहाकम्बुर्दीप्तपावकसन्निभः |
बभूवेन्द्रजितः केतुर्वैदूर्यसमलंकृतः
verses.iast:
jāmbūnadamahākamburdīptapāvakasannibhaḥ |
babhūvendrajitaḥ keturvaidūryasamalaṅkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The flag-post of Indrajit shone like a flaming fire, provided, as it was, with large rings of gold and decorated with cat's eye gems.

glosses.meaning: provided as it was with large rings of gold
and decorated with cats's eye gems.

verses.devanagari:
तेन चादित्यकल्पेन ब्रह्मस्त्रेण च पालितः |
स बभूव दुराधर्षो रावणिः सुमहाबलः
verses.iast:
tena cādityakalpena brahmastreṇa ca pālitaḥ |
sa babhūva durādharṣo rāvaṇiḥ sumahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Protected by the missile presided over by Brahma, which was as efflugent as the sun, that Indrajit endowed with exceptional strength, became difficult to be attacked.

glosses.meaning: by the missile presided over by Brahma
which was as efflugent as the sun

verses.devanagari:
सो|अभिनिर्याय नगरादिन्द्रजित्समितिञ्जयः |
हुत्वाग्निं राक्षसैर्मन्रैरन्तर्धानगतो|अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
so | abhiniryāya nagarādindrajitsamitiJṇjayaḥ |
hutvāgniṃ rākṣasairmanrairantardhānagato | abravīt
verses.translation: Coming forth from the city and having acquired the capacity of vanishing from the sight, by offering oblations into the sacred fire, with the uttereance of spells sacred to demons, that indrajit, who was ever victorious in war, spoke as follows:

glosses.meaning: who was ever victorious in war
and having acquired the capacity of vanishing from the sight

verses.devanagari:
अद्य हत्वा रणे यौ तौ मिथ्याप्रव्रजितौ वने |
जयं पित्रे प्रदास्यामि रावणाय रणार्जितम्
verses.iast:
adya hatvā raṇe yau tau mithyāpravrajitau vane |
jayaṃ pitre pradāsyāmi rāvaṇāya raṇārjitam
verses.translation: "By killing both the princes who left home to become religious mendicants in the forest in vain, I will present a gift of victory secured in the battle, to my father, Ravana today."

glosses.meaning: left home to become religious mendicants

verses.devanagari:
अद्य निर्वानरामुर्वीम् हत्वा रामं च लक्ष्मणम् |
करिष्ये परमां प्रीतिमित्युक्त्वान्तरधीयत
verses.iast:
adya nirvānarāmurvīm hatvā rāmaṃ ca lakṣmaṇam |
kariṣye paramāṃ prītimityuktvāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: "By making the earth bereft of monkeys today and by killing Rama and Lakshmana, I will create a great spleasure". Thus speaking, Indrajit vanished from thes sight.

glosses.meaning: by making the earth bereft of monkeys

verses.devanagari:
आपपाताथ सम्क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवेण चोदितः |
तीक्षणकार्मुकनाराचैस्तीक्षणस्त्विन्द्ररिपू रणे
verses.iast:
āpapātātha samkruddho daśagrīveṇa coditaḥ |
tīkṣaṇakārmukanārācaistīkṣaṇastvindraripū raṇe
verses.translation: Impelled, as he was, by Ravana, the fiery Indrajit, with his barbarons bow and steel arrows, swiftly came to the battle-field enraged.

glosses.meaning: with barbarous bow and steel arrows

verses.devanagari:
स ददर्श महावीर्यौ नागौ त्रिशिरसाविव |
सृजन्ताविषुजालानि वीरौ वानरमध्यगौ
verses.iast:
sa dadarśa mahāvīryau nāgau triśirasāviva |
sṛjantāviṣujālāni vīrau vānaramadhyagau
verses.translation: That Indrajit saw the two heroes, showering a multitude of arrows. Both the princes, having mighty prowess, looked like three- hooded serpents in the middle of the monkeys.

verses.devanagari:
इमौ ताविति संचिन्त्य सज्यं कृत्वा च कार्मुकम् |
सन्ततानेषुधाराभिः पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान्
verses.iast:
imau tāviti sañcintya sajyaṃ kṛtvā ca kārmukam |
santatāneṣudhārābhiḥ parjanya iva vṛṣṭimān
verses.translation: Concluding that both of them were the two princes, Rama and Lakshmana and stringing his bow, he covered them with a flood of arrows, as the rainy clouds do.

verses.devanagari:
स तु वैहायसं प्राप्य सरथो रामलक्ष्मणौ |
अचक्षुर्विषये तिष्ठन्विव्याध निशितैः शरैः
verses.iast:
sa tu vaihāyasaṃ prāpya saratho rāmalakṣmaṇau |
acakṣurviṣaye tiṣṭhanvivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
verses.translation: That Indrajit with his chariot, reaching the sky and remaining invisible, struck Rama and Lakshmana with his sharp arrows.

glosses.meaning: and remaining invisible to the reach of eyes

verses.devanagari:
तौ तस्य शरवेगेन परीतौ रामलक्ष्मणौ |
धनुषी सशरे कृत्वा दिव्यमस्त्रं प्रचक्रतुः
verses.iast:
tau tasya śaravegena parītau rāmalakṣmaṇau |
dhanuṣī saśare kṛtvā divyamastraṃ pracakratuḥ
verses.translation: When enveloped by a stream of arrows Rama and Lakshamana, fitted arrows to their bows and revealed divine missiles.

glosses.meaning: by a stream of his arrows

verses.devanagari:
प्रच्छादयन्तौ गगनम् शरजालैर्महाबलौ |
तमस्त्रैः सुरसङ्काशौ नैव पस्पर्शतुः शरैः
verses.iast:
pracchādayantau gaganam śarajālairmahābalau |
tamastraiḥ surasañkāśau naiva pasparśatuḥ śaraiḥ
verses.translation: Though covering the sky with a net-work of arrows, the two mighty princes could not touch Indrajit with their arrows charged with mystic missiles and which were efflugent like the sun.

glosses.meaning: with their arrows charged with mystic missiles

verses.devanagari:
स हि धूमान्धकारं च चक्रे प्रच्छादयन्नभः |
दिशश्चान्तर्दधे श्रीमान्नीहारतमसावृतः
verses.iast:
sa hi dhūmāndhakāraṃ ca cakre pracchādayannabhaḥ |
diśaścāntardadhe śrīmānnīhāratamasāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Covering the sky, the illustrious Indrajit created a dark-like smoke. He made the quarters also invisible, by enclosing them with mist-liek darkness.

verses.devanagari:
नैव ज्यातलनिर्घोषो न च नेमिखुरस्वनः |
शुश्रुवे चरतस्तस्य न च रूपं प्रकाशते
verses.iast:
naiva jyātalanirghoṣo na ca nemikhurasvanaḥ |
śuśruve caratastasya na ca rūpaṃ prakāśate
verses.translation: While Indrajit was moving about, neither the sound produced by the impact of his palm on the bow string was heard, nor the sound of his wheels or the clattering of hoofs of his horses could be heard, nor did his form come tot he view.

glosses.meaning: charitaH = while Indrajit was moving about
the sound produced by the impact of his palm on the bow-string
nor did his form come to view.

verses.devanagari:
घनान्धकारे तिमिरे शरवर्षमिवाद्भुतम् |
स ववर्ष महाबाहुर्नाराचशरवृष्टिभिः
verses.iast:
ghanāndhakāre timire śaravarṣamivādbhutam |
sa vavarṣa mahābāhurnārācaśaravṛṣṭibhiḥ
verses.translation: In that thick darkness, that long-armed Indrajit showered hails of his steel arrows, like wonderful shower of rocks.

verses.devanagari:
स रामं सूर्यसङ्काशैः शरैर्दत्तवरो भृशम् |
विव्याध समरे क्रुद्धः सर्वगात्रेषु रावणिः
verses.iast:
sa rāmaṃ sūryasañkāśaiḥ śarairdattavaro bhṛśam |
vivyādha samare kruddhaḥ sarvagātreṣu rāvaṇiḥ
verses.translation: That enraged Indrajit in battle, abundantly pierced Rama in all his limbs with his arrows, which were earlier granted as boons to him and which were effluent like the sun.

glosses.meaning: and which were afflugent like the sun.

verses.devanagari:
तौ हन्यमानौ नाराचैर्धाराभिरिव पर्वतौ |
हेमपुङ्खान्नरव्याघ्रौ तिग्मान्मुमुचतुः शरान्
verses.iast:
tau hanyamānau nārācairdhārābhiriva parvatau |
hemapuñkhānnaravyāghrau tigmānmumucatuḥ śarān
verses.translation: Both Rama and Lakshmana, the foremost of men, who were being struck with steel arrows, like two mountains being hit by torrents, released sharp golden-shafted arrows.

verses.devanagari:
अन्तरिक्षं समासाद्य रावणिं कङ्कपत्रिणः |
निकृत्य पतगा भूमौ पेतुस्ते शोणितोक्षिताः
verses.iast:
antarikṣaṃ samāsādya rāvaṇiṃ kañkapatriṇaḥ |
nikṛtya patagā bhūmau petuste śoṇitokṣitāḥ
verses.translation: Those arrows, adorned with plumes of heron, reaching Indrajit in the sky and piercing him, fell to the ground, soaked in blood.

verses.devanagari:
अतिमात्रं शरौघेण पीड्यमानौ नरोत्तमौ |
तानिषून्पततो भल्लैरनेकैर्निचकर्ततुः
verses.iast:
atimātraṃ śaraugheṇa pīḍyamānau narottamau |
tāniṣūnpatato bhallairanekairnicakartatuḥ
verses.translation: Shining beyond measure with a flood of arrows, the two excellent men began to chop off those arrows which were falling on them with many arrows called by the name of Bhallas.

glosses.meaning: called by the name of Bhallas.

verses.devanagari:
यतो हि ददृशाते तौ शरान्निपतिताञ्शितान् |
ततस्ततो दाशरथी ससृजातेऽस्त्रमुत्तमम्
verses.iast:
yato hi dadṛśāte tau śarānnipatitāñśitān |
tatastato dāśarathī sasṛjāte'stramuttamam
verses.translation: Both Rama and Lakshmana for their part directed their excellent missiles in the direction from which they saw the aforesaid sharp arrows, fallen.

verses.devanagari:
रावणिस्तु दिशः सर्वा रथेनातिरथः पतन् |
विव्याध तौ दाशरथी लघ्वस्त्रो निशितैः शरैः
verses.iast:
rāvaṇistu diśaḥ sarvā rathenātirathaḥ patan |
vivyādha tau dāśarathī laghvastro niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
verses.translation: Indrajit for his part, who was a superior chariot-warrior and who was swift in discharging missiles, rushed on towards all sides and pierced Rama and Lakshmana with his sharp arrows.

glosses.meaning: who was a superior chariot = warrior
and who was swift in discharging missiles

verses.devanagari:
तेनातिविद्धौ तौ वीरौ रुक्मपुङ्खैः सुसंहतैः |
बभूवतुर्दाशरथी पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ
verses.iast:
tenātividdhau tau vīrau rukmapuñkhaiḥ susaṃhataiḥ |
babhūvaturdāśarathī puṣpitāviva kiṃśukau
verses.translation: Those valiant princes, Rama and Lakshmana pierced deeply with well-made goldne shafted arrows, appeared like two Kamshuka trees in flowering.

verses.devanagari:
नास्य वेद गतिं कश्चिन्न च रूपं धनुः शरान् |
न चान्यद्विदितं किं चित्सूर्यस्येवाभ्रसम्प्लवे
verses.iast:
nāsya veda gatiṃ kaścinna ca rūpaṃ dhanuḥ śarān |
na cānyadviditaṃ kiṃ citsūryasyevābhrasamplave
verses.translation: No one could perceive his rapid movement, like the position of the sun when the sky is thickly overcast with clouds, nor his form nor his bows and arrows, nor any other thing about him whatsoever could be known.

glosses.meaning: like the position of the sun
when the sky is thickly overcast with clouds
nor any other thing about him

verses.devanagari:
तेन विद्धाश्च हरयो निहताश्च गतासवः |
बभूवुः शतशस्तत्र पतिता धरणीतले
verses.iast:
tena viddhāśca harayo nihatāśca gatāsavaḥ |
babhūvuḥ śataśastatra patitā dharaṇītale
verses.translation: Struck down by him, the monkeys were killed. The monkeys dropped dead in hundreds on the earth's surface there.

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणस्तु सुसङ्क्रुद्धो भ्रातरं वाक्यमब्रवीत् |
ब्राह्ममस्त्रं प्रयोक्ष्यामि वधार्थं सर्वरक्षसाम्
verses.iast:
lakṣmaṇastu susañkruddho bhrātaraṃ vākyamabravīt |
brāhmamastraṃ prayokṣyāmi vadhārthaṃ sarvarakṣasām
verses.translation: Then, Lakshmana for his part was enraged and told his brother that he would employ the missile presided over by Brahma for the purpose of killing all the demons.

glosses.meaning: the missile presided over by Brahama

verses.devanagari:
तमुवाच ततो रामो लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम् |
नैकस्य हेतो रक्षांसि पृथिव्यां हन्तुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
tamuvāca tato rāmo lakṣmaṇaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam |
naikasya heto rakṣāṃsi pṛthivyāṃ hantumarhasi
verses.translation: Then, Rama spoke to that Lakshmana, who was endowed with auspicious bodily marks as follows: "You ought not to kill all the demons on earth, merely for the sake of a single demon."

glosses.meaning: who was endowed with auspicious bodily marks
for the sake of a single demons.

verses.devanagari:
अयुध्यमानं प्रच्छन्नं प्राञ्जलिं शरणागतम् |
पलायन्तं प्रमत्तं वा न त्वं हन्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.iast:
ayudhyamānaṃ pracchannaṃ prāñjaliṃ śaraṇāgatam |
palāyantaṃ pramattaṃ vā na tvaṃ hantumihārhasi
verses.translation: "You ought not to kill on this earth one who is not fighting or one who is hiding or one who seeks refuge with joined palms or is fleeing or is intoxicated."

glosses.meaning: or the one who is a refugee

verses.devanagari:
अस्यैव तु वधे यत्नं करिष्यावो महाबल |
आदेक्ष्यावो महावेगानस्त्रानाशीविषोपमान्
verses.iast:
asyaiva tu vadhe yatnaṃ kariṣyāvo mahābala |
ādekṣyāvo mahāvegānastrānāśīviṣopamān
verses.translation: "O long-armed Lakshmana! We shall try to kill Indrajit alone. We will employ mystic mssiles with great impetuosity and which are equal to venomous serpents."

glosses.meaning: and which are equal to venomous serpents.

verses.devanagari:
तमेनं मायिनं क्षुद्रमन्तर्हितरथं बलात् |
राक्षसं निहनिष्यन्ति दृष्ट्वा वानरयूथपाः
verses.iast:
tamenaṃ māyinaṃ kṣudramantarhitarathaṃ balāt |
rākṣasaṃ nihaniṣyanti dṛṣṭvā vānarayūthapāḥ
verses.translation: "On seeing this demons, the leaders of mokey-troops will forcibly kill this petty demon, who is skilled in conjuring tricks and whose chariot remains invisible."

glosses.meaning: who is skilled in conjuring tricks

verses.devanagari:
यद्येष भूमिं विशते दिवं वा |
रसातलं वापि नभस्तलं वा |
एवं निगूढोऽपि ममास्त्रदग्धः |
पतिष्यते भूमितले गतासुः
verses.iast:
yadyeṣa bhūmiṃ viśate divaṃ vā |
rasātalaṃ vāpi nabhastalaṃ vā |
evaṃ nigūḍho'pi mamāstradagdhaḥ |
patiṣyate bhūmitale gatāsuḥ
verses.translation: "Scorched by my mystic missiles, he will fall dead on the ground, even if he enters the earth or into heaven or into the subterrranean world or penetrates the vault of heaven and remains completely hidden in this manner."

glosses.meaning: or penetrates the vault of heaven

verses.devanagari:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं महात्मा |
रघुप्रवीरः प्लवगर्षभैर्वृतः |
वधाय रौद्रस्य नृशंसकर्मणस् |
तदा महात्मा त्वरितं निरीक्षते
verses.iast:
ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ mahātmā |
raghupravīraḥ plavagarṣabhairvṛtaḥ |
vadhāya raudrasya nṛśaṃsakarmaṇas |
tadā mahātmā tvaritaṃ nirīkṣate
verses.translation: Speaking highly meaningful words in the aforesaid manner, the great-souled Rama, surrounded by the foremost of monkeys, started to reflect on the speedy means of killing the furious Indrajit, the demons of cruel deeds.
